notes.title: Update: version 2.41 · ◡ ·
notes.content:
Hi friends! Some friends and fixes for you today!

The main thing is I have tried (again) to perminently fix the "all achievements bug" that some people have messaged me about.

Firstly, sorry about this! Secondly, if you have had this issue but have all the other achievements, you can now go to the main CAFE and press the 'O' key on your keyboard. This will run the check manually and award you the achievement if you got all the rest before.
If this doesn't work, or you have any problems with this or other stuff please do message me!
When going through the issues I decided to reduce the timers for achievements, as I think sometimes people had quit to menu before they have triggered in the past (the "all achievements" used to take 4 seconds to allow the other achievement time on screen). Hope this new way works nicely!

I also added some random friends around the place, so have a look out when you are next playing :)

Lots of love and I hope you are having a great day.
HAPPY SNAKE

notes.title: Update: version 2.3 · ◡ ·
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Happy Friday!
Here's some changes and fixes to QT :)

Firstly, some achievement changes that I've talked about for a while:
[list]
[*] "have fun with the dear" has now been updated to be easier and simpler to get!!! I've had a couple requests to do this due to how hard and confusing it is to get. It's still somewhat mysterious, but much easier to stumble on now :)
[*] "dont.look.behind.you" has now been changed to "◠‿◠". This is to avoid the common confusion of thinking it was to do with the note at the start of QT that reads "look behind you". (Sorry about all the time I wasted with this oversight haha :p)
[*] "???????" has now been changed to "7". Most people found it frustrating to figure out, and different region keyboards could have trouble getting it. I'm hoping now it's just funny instead of frustrating.
[/list]


The other changes are:
[list]
[*] Bigger collision boxes on the notes in QT (less precise aim needed to interact)
[*] The clue on the light has an added character drawn on it for better identification
[*] Ladybugs on the main door disappear now when it's opened :)
[*] Door blocking spider hit boxes made taller
[*] The "7" achievement friend now appears in a different spot as to not be blocked by the UI.
[/list]


Hope you enjoy these changes and have an amazing weekend!
Take care,
HAPPY SNAKE <3

notes.title: Update: version 1.99 · ◡ ·
notes.content:
Version 1.99 is out!!!

Thanks so much to everyone for helping QT get to this point! Version 1.99 is here, and on Thursday will be 2.0 (which will just be little tweaks and updates from what we have today).

BIG CHANGES! The QT part's art has been completely redone and the there is a WHOLE NEW AREA replacing the area when you leave through the front door!!!!!!

I've wanted to update the art style for QT since release, as I thought it should feel closer to the other two games. After many months of work we are finally here and I'm really excited today and Thursday to share it with you all!

A quick rundown of the new changes:

[list]
[*] ALL NEW ART IN THE QT PART
[*] WHOLE NEW AREA (replacing the old part after you walk through the main door)
[*] LOTS OF NEW FRIENDS AND PROPS IN THE QT PART
[/list]

Smaller changes:
[list]
[*] Main door stays open now if you have opened it (between saves too)
[*] Removed skipping the first level if you've done it before (on restart)
[*] The later section no longer removes the music or locks the door behind you!!!
[*] Updated the screenshots on itch and Steam
[*] Radio doesn't play if the door is open (you can still use it as you want)
[*] Moved some of the other characters and posters around
[*] Added a late Kickstarter backer character ;)
[*] New interact UI colours
[/list]


So happy to have this ready for everyone to play and hope people really like the update! Please let me know what you think and if there is anything that you really think should be improved :)

Have an awesome evening, lots and lots of love
HAPPY SNAKE <3

notes.title: Update: version 1.981 · ◡ ·
notes.content:
Happy Monday everyone!

Today's update is just fixing a problem that has persisted in which you don't correctly get the 100% achievements achievement.

If you have encountered this problem and are still on the save where you got 100% and didn't get the achievement, I have created a quick way that you can get it without resetting your save file!

Steps to fixing a save where you should have received the 100% achievement:
1.) Go to MUSEUM
2.) Press Control-Shift-O and a menu appears. Click "achievement problem" and close the menu. This deletes the "fashion is not interactive" achievement.
3.) Go to settings and restart the current level (applies changes).
4.) Now walk up the stairs on the right and touch the frog fashion exhibit to get the achievement again and wait 10 seconds for the game to register the 100% achievement:D

That should fix it for everyone, but if it doesn't please please let me know and I will sort it out for you. (If these steps weren't clear too, please ask me questions).

Sorry this bug has been in here, it's such a demoralizing thing to happen to your save!

Hope everyone has a fantastic week,
HAPPY SNAKE :D

notes.title: Update: version 1.96 · ◡ ·
notes.content:
HEY!
I'm so happy to have this complete! 1.96 is here and live :D
Here's a tiny trailer I made - https://youtu.be/Tz2iRqS0STY

Main updates:
- GAMEPAD + Keymapping support!!! 
- All new settings + menus, including advanced graphics options! + main menu game select
- New QT ending
- Improved performance (especially in MUSEUM and KOUEN)

small things
- A dozen QT things (see below)
- Improved localization (now needs restart if you switch languages)
- Easter eggs (qt and museum) ;)
- Improved the achievement popup UI

Gamepad support should work out the box (especially the analog sticks) but there's a chance you might want to remap some of the keys.
The keymapping screen is still a little basic and can be difficult to read, but I will make this better in a future update.
I think all the keyboard keys are the same, so it shouldn't change anything for people just playing on PC.

If you have ANY problems with input/performance/anything please message me anywhere (discord, twitter DM, email) as I really want to fix any issues i might not have caught when testing.


New QT ending
So, I've been planning this QT update since release, but it's hard to do as it can break a lot of other parts of the game... so when I broke everything adding the new input I thought I could add it as I have to test so much anyway! The important changes are in (yellow frog friend is slightly different now, and a tiny bit easier) plus I properly removed jumping and added something way cooler for the final friend ending.
I will be adding a little more to this ending, but the main important bits are there and I'm really really happy with how it turned out.

New other QT things! :D
- new photo fragment view thing
- photo fragments + picture are now in lovely colour
- main door part has some new assets
- goose painting cannot be accessed through the wall now ;)
- better looping camera animation (smoother)
- fixed some of the silly z-fighting on the walls
- redrew the potted plant! looking good now

Really happy with this update and have a dozen more things I want to add to it soon. Hope everyone is doing okay!

- Happy Snake xx

p.s OST coming soon!

notes.title: Update: version 1.92 · ◡ ·
notes.content:
Hello :)

Today is another little update to the game as I work for the bigger update 2.0. That being said, I have added a very important feature!

The QT part of the game now saves some of your progress, which means you don't have to do the same collecting each time you play (unless you want to).
To access this feature you do have to complete the game once more though, then on the bathroom door and near the main door there are paintings that let you open them as it knows you have completed it once :D

I'm hoping this is a great addition to the game and means people have more fun and less wasted time. If you still have achievements to collect, you can still easily travel the rest of the corridor loops like normal :)

The second additions to 1.92 are the pond in the deer area of KOUEN. I have now added cute fish and some pond plants, as I felt this area needed some additional beauty!

Thanks to everyone that has been playing QT! The reviews are very lovely and kind so thank you!

- Happy Snake
